resources.string: PiuLink requests Android Accessibility access only to forward PC keyboard shortcuts that Android normally handles.

While a streaming session is active and shortcut interception is turned on, PiuLink can receive hardware key presses, including system shortcuts such as Alt+Tab and the Windows key. It does not read screen content or accessibility events.
How the key presses are used
Key presses are sent directly to the paired PC you selected so that PC can respond. PiuLink does not store them or send them to PiuLink servers.
This access is optional. You can stream without it and let Android continue handling system shortcuts.
